SEGCYCLE.EnabledHint: Turns the whole Day/Night tracker on or off for you.
SEGCYCLE.LayoutHint: Split shows Day and Night as two separate bars. Combined shows both bars together in one frame. Transition shows a single bar that flips from Day to Night once Day is full.
SEGCYCLE.BgTransparentHint: When on, the bar background uses the opacity slider below instead of the default solid look.
SEGCYCLE.BgOpacityHint: Only applies when transparent background is on.
